amasi-scones: tall South African amasi scones: a cluster of golden, craggy-topped scones on a honey-oak board, one split open to show the soft, steaming crumb, with a little dish of butter, a jar of apricot jam with a spoon and a small bowl of grated cheddar.
baked-falafel-wraps: baked falafel wraps, close and generous, filling most of the frame: three wholewheat wraps cut in half on the diagonal and stacked on a honey-oak board, each cut face showing golden-brown baked falafel, a smear of creamy hummus, shredded green lettuce, red tomato slices, cucumber sticks and bright orange grated carrot. banana-bread: a loaf of moist, golden-brown banana bread with a cracked, caramelised top, three thick slices cut and fanned out on a honey-oak board, one spread with melting butter, a ripe banana beside it.
banana-oat-pancakes: banana oat pancakes, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a short, slightly uneven stack of four small, thick, soft pancakes, evenly golden-brown with smooth edges and visible flecks of oats, on a blush plate, a spoonful of thick white plain yoghurt sliding off the top, fresh strawberries, blueberries and banana slices scattered over and around them, a fork resting on the plate with a torn-off bite showing the soft, moist inside.

beef-and-broccoli-stir-fry: a beef and broccoli stir-fry in a matte black cast-iron pan: thin strips of seared rump in a dark, glossy garlic and soy sauce with bright green broccoli florets, slices of carrot and strips of red pepper, sliced spring onion on top, a portion lifted out onto a cream stoneware plate of brown rice beside it, steam rising from the pan; close and generous, filling most of the frame.

beef-stew-with-dombolo: South African beef stew with dombolo: a matte black cast-iron pot of tender beef chunks in a rich, glossy brown gravy with carrots and potatoes, three round, pale, fluffy steamed-bread dumplings sitting on top, one torn open to show its soft crumb, a wooden spoon resting on the rim.
beetroot-salad: a South African beetroot salad: glossy ruby-red cubes and slices of boiled beetroot tossed with thin rings of white onion in a sweet-sour vinegar dressing, in a shallow cream stoneware bowl, a few parsley leaves on top.
berry-smoothie-bowl: a berry smoothie bowl, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a cream stoneware bowl of thick, spoonable, deep magenta-purple blended berry and banana smoothie, its surface smooth like soft-serve, topped in neat rows with pale banana coins, a scattering of green pumpkin seeds and sunflower seeds, and a glossy ribbon of peanut butter drizzled across, a spoon resting in the bowl with a little smoothie heaped on it.
bobotie: a Cape Malay bobotie: curry-spiced beef mince with raisins baked in a cream stoneware dish under a set, golden, lightly blistered egg custard with bay leaves pressed into the top, one portion spooned out to show the moist mince layer. boeber: boeber, a warm Cape Malay milk pudding: creamy milk with toasted vermicelli and soft translucent sago, flecked with cardamom and topped with flaked almonds and a cinnamon stick, in two cream stoneware bowls, steam rising.
boerewors-breakfast: a South African weekend breakfast: a coil of browned boerewors, two sunny fried eggs and thick slices of buttered toast on a cream stoneware plate, with a spoonful of soft, glossy tomato and onion smoor, a cast-iron pan just behind.
boerewors-rolls: two boerie rolls: braaied boerewors with dark grill marks in toasted, buttered soft rolls, topped with a chunky tomato and onion relish and a line of yellow mustard, on baking paper on a honey-oak board.
boerewors-stew: boerewors stew: thick chunks of browned boerewors with potatoes and carrots in a rich, glossy tomato and onion gravy, in a matte black cast-iron pot, a wooden spoon resting in it, a bowl of white pap beside it.
boontjiesop: boontjiesop, Karoo bean soup: a thick, velvety brown sugar-bean soup with tender shreds of beef shin, in a deep cream stoneware bowl, a swirl of cream and chopped parsley on top, a thick slice of buttered farm bread beside it.
braaibroodjies: braaibroodjies: a stack of golden, grill-marked toasted sandwiches cut in half to show oozing melted cheese, tomato slices, onion and a layer of chutney, on a honey-oak board.
braaied-lamb-chops: South African braaied lamb loin chops: six chops with crisp, charred fat edges and pink centres, glistening with garlic, lemon and rosemary, piled on a honey-oak board with grilled lemon halves and rosemary sprigs.
braaied-mielies: braaied mielies: four whole corn cobs charred in spots from the coals, glistening with melted butter and dusted with chicken spice, on a long honey-oak board with a small dish of soft butter.

braaied-steak-chimichurri-salad: a braaied steak salad with chimichurri, close and generous, filling most of the frame: thick slices of rump steak, charred and crusted on the outside and pink in the middle, fanned over a big salad of mixed leaves, halved cherry tomatoes, cucumber half-moons, thin strips of red pepper, slivers of red onion and avocado on a honey-oak board. brandy-tart: a Cape brandy tart: a dark, soft date and walnut sponge glistening with soaked-in buttery brandy syrup in a cream stoneware baking dish, one square served on a blush-pink plate with a dollop of whipped cream.

bunny-chow: a Durban bunny chow: a quarter loaf of unsliced white bread hollowed out and filled to the brim with a glossy orange-red sugar-bean and potato curry, the scooped-out bread plug leaning against its side, on a cream stoneware plate with a small bowl of grated carrot and chilli sambal.
buttermilk-rusks: South African buttermilk rusks: a pile of golden, twice-baked rusk fingers on a honey-oak board, one dunked into a cup of coffee in a cream stoneware mug, crumbs scattered.
butternut-chickpea-curry: a butternut and chickpea curry, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a cream stoneware bowl of soft orange butternut cubes and golden chickpeas in a thick, brick-red tomato curry sauce with dark green wilted spinach folded through and a cinnamon stick on top, served beside a mound of brown rice, with a little bowl of fresh tomato, red onion and coriander sambal, a spoon lifting a chunk of butternut and steam rising.
butternut-soup: a velvety, bright orange butternut soup in a wide cream stoneware bowl, with a swirl of cream, a pinch of curry spice and a few pumpkin seeds on top, two slices of toast beside it, steam rising.
cape-malay-chicken-curry: a Cape Malay chicken curry: tender chicken pieces and potatoes in a fragrant, golden-orange curry sauce with a cinnamon stick, cardamom pods and fresh coriander, in a cream stoneware pot, a bowl of white rice and a small dish of sambal beside it.
chakalaka: chakalaka: a cast-iron pan of spicy South African vegetable relish, soft onions, red and green peppers, grated carrot and baked beans in a thick curried tomato sauce, a spoon in it, beside a cream plate with a mound of white pap and a coil of braaied boerewors.
chicken-a-la-king: chicken à la king: tender chicken, sliced mushrooms and red and green peppers in a creamy, velvety white sauce spooned over fluffy white rice in a shallow cream stoneware bowl, a scattering of parsley.

chicken-gizzards: spicy South African chicken gizzards: tender gizzards in a rich red curry, tomato and green pepper gravy in a matte black cast-iron pan, a mound of white pap on a cream plate beside it.

chutney-chicken: chutney chicken: golden chicken pieces baked under a sticky, caramelised fruit chutney and onion sauce, glistening in a cream stoneware baking dish, a bowl of white rice beside it.
cottage-pie: a cottage pie in a cream stoneware baking dish: savoury beef mince with carrots and peas under a buttery mashed potato lid with forked ridges baked golden brown, one portion spooned out to show the layers, steam rising.

cremora-tart: a no-bake Cremora tart: a pale, mousse-like, tangy creamy filling in a golden biscuit crust in a round pie dish, one neat slice lifted out onto a blush-pink plate.

denningvleis: denningvleis, Cape Malay sweet-sour lamb stew: tender, bone-in lamb in a dark, glossy tamarind and onion gravy with bay leaves and allspice, in a matte black cast-iron pot, a bowl of yellow rice beside it.

hertzoggies: hertzoggies: buttery pastry tartlets filled with apricot jam under a chewy, lightly golden coconut meringue, arranged on a cream cake stand, one broken open to show the jam.
hoenderpastei: a Cape hoenderpastei, chicken pie: golden, flaky puff pastry on a deep cream stoneware pie dish, one portion cut out to show creamy chicken, sliced boiled egg and a lemony sauce inside, steam rising.

koesisters: Cape Malay koesisters: soft, oval, spiced doughnuts glistening with syrup and rolled in desiccated coconut, piled on a cream stoneware plate, one torn open to show the fluffy inside.

mabele-porridge: mabele, sorghum porridge: smooth, earthy, pinkish-brown porridge in a cream stoneware bowl, with a splash of milk, a melting knob of butter and a drizzle of honey.
macaroni-cheese: a baked macaroni cheese in a cream stoneware dish, the top golden and bubbling with melted cheddar and slices of tomato, a corner already scooped out to show the creamy, cheesy macaroni, a serving spoon lying in the dish.
malva-pudding: a South African malva pudding: a square of soft, spongy, deep caramel-brown sponge glistening with soaked-in butter and cream sauce, served warm in a cream stoneware bowl with a pour of yellow custard running around it, the baking dish with the rest of the pudding just behind.

melkkos: melkkos: a creamy, gently lumpy milk porridge in a cream stoneware bowl, under a thick blanket of cinnamon sugar with a melting knob of butter, steam rising.
melktert: a South African milk tart: a whole tart in a fluted sweet-pastry shell with a smooth, pale cream custard filling dusted with ground cinnamon, one slice cut out and set on a small blush-pink plate beside it, a glass cup of rooibos tea.
mielie-fritters: mielie fritters: golden, crisp-edged sweetcorn fritters with whole kernels showing, stacked on a cream stoneware plate, with a small dish of sweet chilli sauce.
mieliebrood: mieliebrood: a moist, golden sweetcorn loaf with kernels showing, two thick warm slices cut and spread with melting butter, on a honey-oak board.
mieliepap: mieliepap: smooth, creamy white maize porridge in a cream stoneware bowl, with a pour of cold milk, a melting knob of butter and a sprinkle of sugar.
mince-jaffles: mince jaffles: crisp, golden, sealed round toasted sandwiches from a jaffle iron, one cut open to show curried savoury mince and melted cheese oozing out, on a honey-oak board.

monkeygland-steak: monkeygland steak: a thick, pan-seared rump steak sliced to show its pink centre, under a dark, glossy, sweet and tangy onion and chutney sauce, on a cream stoneware plate with thick-cut chips.
morogo: morogo, wild spinach: deep-green cooked greens with soft onion and fresh tomato in a cream stoneware bowl, beside a mound of firm white stywe pap.

pampoenkoekies: pampoenkoekies, pumpkin fritters: golden pan-fried rounds dusted with cinnamon sugar, stacked on a blush-pink plate, with a little jug of warm caramel sauce being drizzled over.

peri-peri-chicken-livers: peri-peri chicken livers: seared chicken livers in a creamy, garlicky, orange-red peri-peri sauce in a small matte black cast-iron pan, with crusty Portuguese rolls torn open beside it.
pickled-fish: Cape pickled fish: pieces of fried hake layered with golden onion rings in a sweet-sour curry vinegar sauce, in a glass dish, with a bay leaf and peppercorns, a slice of buttered bread beside it.
pilchard-curry: South African pilchard curry with brown rice, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a cream stoneware bowl of brown rice topped with large, whole pieces of silvery-skinned pilchard in a thick, glossy, red-brown tomato and onion masala with bright green peas, wilted spinach and a few curry leaves, sprinkled with chopped coriander and steam rising. Beside it a small bowl of finely diced fresh tomato and onion sambal.
pilchard-fishcakes: pilchard fishcakes: golden, crisp-edged fishcakes on a cream stoneware plate, one broken open to show the soft centre flecked with parsley, with lemon wedges and a little bowl of tomato sauce.
pork-fillet-apple-traybake: a pork fillet traybake with apple and butternut, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a black enamel roasting tray of golden roasted butternut cubes with browned edges, soft purple-red onion wedges, blistered red-skinned apple wedges and bright green beans, two pork fillets on top with a mustard, paprika and thyme crust, one sliced into thick rounds showing a juicy, just-white centre with a faint blush, tray juices glistening underneath.
potato-salad: a South African potato salad: tender potato chunks and chopped boiled egg in a creamy mayonnaise dressing with spring onion and parsley, in a cream stoneware bowl.
prego-rolls: prego rolls: thin, garlicky, seared steak tucked into soft Portuguese rolls, glistening with peri-peri pan juices, on a honey-oak board with a small bowl of extra sauce.
roast-leg-of-lamb: a roast leg of lamb studded with garlic and rosemary, crisp and golden outside, a few slices carved to show the pink, juicy inside, on a honey-oak board with roast potatoes and a little jug of gravy.
roosterkoek: roosterkoek: crusty, grill-marked braai bread rolls, one split open and steaming with melting butter, apricot jam and a slice of cheddar, piled on a honey-oak board.
roti: South African roti: a stack of soft, flaky, layered flatbreads with golden-brown spots, one folded and torn to show the layers, on a honey-oak board beside a small bowl of curry.
sago-pudding: a baked sago pudding: soft, translucent sago custard over a layer of apricot jam, under a golden, peaked meringue, in a cream stoneware baking dish with one portion spooned out.
salmon-poke-bowls: salmon poke bowls, close and generous, filling most of the frame: two cream stoneware bowls of nutty brown rice topped in neat sections with sticky, glazed golden salmon cubes, bright green edamame beans, thin cucumber slices, a pile of grated carrot and fanned slices of ripe avocado, scattered with sliced spring onion and toasted sesame seeds, a lime half on the rim and a little glaze drizzled glistening over the salmon.
salmon-sweet-potato-traybake: a salmon, sweet potato and broccoli traybake, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a black enamel roasting tray of four pink salmon fillets, skin on, their tops glossy with a speckled wholegrain mustard and lemon glaze and just flaking at the edges, surrounded by caramelised orange chunks of sweet potato, soft red onion wedges and broccoli florets with charred tips, lemon wedges tucked in the corners, one fillet lifted with a spatula to show its moist, opaque flakes.
samoosas: samoosas: crisp, golden pastry triangles piled on a cream stoneware plate, one broken open to show spiced beef mince with coriander, with lemon wedges and a small bowl of chutney.
shakshuka: shakshuka, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a wide matte black cast-iron pan of thick, deep-red tomato and pepper sauce with soft pieces of red and green pepper, eight eggs nestled in hollows with set white rims and glossy, runny golden yolks, a dusting of smoked paprika and a scatter of chopped coriander and parsley. A spoon has lifted out one egg with its sauce, the yolk just breaking, and steam rises from the pan.
slap-chips: South African slap chips: a generous pile of thick-cut, soft, golden-tinged fried potato chips, glistening with vinegar and sprinkled with flaky salt, a few bent and soft, on crumpled baking paper on a honey-oak board, a small dish of tomato sauce beside them.
slow-cooker-chicken-cacciatore: slow-cooker chicken cacciatore, close and generous, filling most of the frame: tender chicken thigh pieces falling apart in a thick, glossy, brick-red tomato sauce with strips of soft red and green pepper, sliced brown mushrooms and halved black olives, scattered with chopped parsley, spooned over a mound of brown rice in a shallow cream stoneware bowl with a bundle of bright green beans beside it. The rest sits in a matte black cast-iron pot alongside, a spoon lifting out a piece of chicken, steam rising.
smoorsnoek: smoorsnoek: flaked smoked snoek braised with soft onions, potatoes and tomato, served over white rice in a cream stoneware bowl, a small dish of apricot jam beside it.
snoek-pate: smoked snoek pâté: a smoky, lemony spread swirled in a cream stoneware bowl with parsley and black pepper, crackers and toast fingers beside it, a lemon wedge.
soetkoekies: soetkoekies: thin, crisp, spiced round biscuits stacked and scattered on a honey-oak board, a cinnamon stick and a few cloves beside them.
soetpampoen: soetpampoen, sweet cinnamon pumpkin: glossy chunks of pumpkin caramelised at the edges in butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, in a cream stoneware dish.
soetpatats: soetpatats, glazed sweet potatoes: thick slices of sweet potato coated in a sticky caramel cinnamon syrup, glistening in a cream stoneware dish.
soji: Durban soji: a soft, fragrant golden semolina pudding with sultanas and flaked almonds, flecked with cardamom, in a cream stoneware bowl, a spoon in it.
sosaties: sosaties: skewers of curried lamb threaded with dried apricots and onion, charred and glistening with a sweet-sour curry glaze, laid across a honey-oak board.
sousboontjies: sousboontjies: speckled sugar beans in a thick, glossy, sweet-sour sauce, in a cream stoneware bowl with a spoon.
souskluitjies: souskluitjies: soft, pale, puffed spoon dumplings sitting in a glistening pool of golden, buttery cinnamon-sugar syrup in a cream stoneware bowl, syrup running down their sides, a dusting of cinnamon on top, one dumpling broken open to show its light, fluffy inside.
spaghetti-bolognese: spaghetti bolognese: a twirl of spaghetti in a wide cream stoneware bowl, topped with a rich beef mince and tomato sauce and a generous grating of cheese, a few basil leaves.
sticky-braai-ribs: sticky braai pork ribs: a rack of spare ribs glazed dark and glossy with a sweet, tangy basting, charred at the edges, a few ribs cut apart, on a long honey-oak board.
stywe-pap: stywe pap: firm, smooth white maize porridge shaped into neat mounds on a cream stoneware plate, with a small bowl of tomato and onion sauce beside it.
sugar-bean-curry: a Durban sugar bean curry, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a cream stoneware bowl of speckled pinky-brown sugar beans and soft golden chunks of potato in a thick, rust-red tomato and masala gravy, a few glossy dark fried curry leaves and chopped coriander on top, a mound of brown rice at one side and a spoon resting in the gravy. Beside it a small cream stoneware bowl of fresh kachumbar of grated orange carrot, diced tomato, cucumber and onion glistening with vinegar.
sunday-roast-chicken: a South African Sunday lunch plate: golden spiced roast chicken with white rice and gravy, ruby-red beetroot salad, cinnamon butternut, coleslaw and potato salad, colourfully arranged on a large cream stoneware plate.
sweet-and-sour-pork-stir-fry: a sweet and sour pork stir-fry: tender strips of browned pork with chunks of red and green pepper, onion petals, carrot slices and golden pineapple pieces in a glossy, translucent orange-red sauce, scattered with sliced spring onion and spooned generously over brown rice in a wide cream stoneware bowl, the sauce pooling at the edges and steam rising; close and generous, filling most of the frame.
sweet-potato-black-bean-chilli: sweet potato and black bean chilli, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a matte black cast-iron pot of thick, smoky brick-red chilli packed with soft orange sweet potato cubes, glossy black beans and red pepper, a ladle lifting a spoonful out. Beside it a cream stoneware bowl of brown rice topped with the chilli, diced green avocado, chopped coriander and a lime wedge.
tamatiebredie: tamatiebredie: bone-in lamb and potatoes in a thick, glossy, sweet-sour red tomato gravy in a matte black cast-iron pot, a bowl of white rice beside it.
tandoori-chicken-skewers: tandoori chicken skewers with raita, close and generous, filling most of the frame: six wooden skewers of chunky chicken thigh pieces, deep orange-red from the spiced yoghurt marinade and charred black at the edges, laid across a honey-oak board, one skewer pulled apart to show the juicy white inside. Beside them a small cream stoneware bowl of thick white cucumber-mint raita flecked with green, a bowl of diced tomato, cucumber and red onion salad scattered with coriander, and lemon wedges.
teriyaki-chicken-rice-bowls: teriyaki chicken rice bowls, close and generous, filling most of the frame: two cream stoneware bowls of brown rice topped with golden chicken thigh pieces in a dark, glossy soy-and-ginger glaze, bright green broccoli florets, orange carrot coins, strips of red pepper and halved mange tout, scattered with sliced spring onion and pale toasted sesame seeds, a little glaze pooling into the rice and steam rising from the nearer bowl, a pair of chopsticks resting across its rim.
ting-le-tshohlo: ting le tshohlo: a mound of soft, slightly sour fermented sorghum pap beside a generous pile of salty, slow-boiled beef pulled into threads, on a cream stoneware plate.
trifle: a South African trifle in a glass bowl, showing its layers: jam Swiss roll slices, red jelly, peaches, yellow custard and whipped cream on top, a serving spoon beside it.
trinchado: trinchado: cubes of tender rump in a rich, garlicky red-wine and peri-peri sauce in a small matte black cast-iron pan, with crusty bread rolls beside it.
tuna-nicoise-salad: a tuna niçoise salad, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a wide cream stoneware platter of torn cos lettuce topped with halved baby potatoes, bright green beans, halved cherry tomatoes, cucumber slices, black olives and flakes of tuna, with quartered boiled eggs showing firm golden yolks, the whole salad glossy with a creamy mustard and lemon dressing. Beside it a glass lunchbox jar packed in neat visible layers, potatoes and beans at the bottom, tuna and egg in the middle and lettuce on top.
tuna-pasta-bake: a tuna pasta bake: penne, tuna and sweetcorn in a cheesy white sauce, golden and bubbling on top, in a cream stoneware baking dish, one portion spooned out.
umleqwa: umleqwa: tender, browned free-range chicken pieces in a rich onion and tomato gravy in a matte black cast-iron pot, a mound of white pap on a cream plate beside it.
umngqusho: umngqusho: creamy samp and sugar beans finished with butter and soft onion, in a cream stoneware bowl with a spoon.
umphokoqo: umphokoqo: crumbly white putu pap in a cream stoneware bowl, with cold, thick amasi poured over the top.
vegetable-egg-fried-rice: vegetable egg fried rice, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a matte black cast-iron wok heaped with separate, lightly toasted grains of brown rice tossed with soft yellow pieces of scrambled egg, bright green peas, golden sweetcorn, shreds of orange carrot, pale cabbage, red pepper and sliced spring onion, glossy with soy sauce, a wooden spoon lifting a portion out with steam rising, a small cream stoneware bowl filled beside it.
vegetable-frittata: a vegetable frittata in a matte black cast-iron pan: thick, puffed golden egg set around diced red pepper, half-moons of baby marrow, dark wilted spinach and blistered halved cherry tomatoes, white crumbles of feta browned at the tips, one wedge cut and lifted out onto a blush plate beside the pan to show the soft, layered yellow inside, with a small green salad of leaves and sliced cucumber; close and generous, filling most of the frame.
vegetable-potjie: a vegetable potjie: a three-legged black cast-iron potjie pot, lid off, with butternut, baby potatoes, mielie wheels, peppers and chickpeas in a smoky tomato sauce, steam rising.
veggie-egg-muffins: veggie egg cups, close and generous, filling most of the frame: a dozen puffed, golden-edged baked egg cups on a honey-oak board, flecked with diced red pepper, green spinach and spring onion, with quartered cherry tomatoes peeking through the tops and melted golden cheddar. A few still sit in their tin, and one is broken in half to show the soft, set, vegetable-studded centre, a little steam rising.
vetkoek-and-mince: vetkoek and mince: golden, puffed fried dough breads split open and filled with gently curried beef mince, on a cream stoneware plate.
yoghurt-berry-parfait: a yoghurt, berry and oat parfait in a clear glass: distinct layers of white yoghurt swirled with pink streaks of crushed berries, golden toasted oats with sunflower and pumpkin seeds, and slices of banana with deep red and purple mixed berries, topped with whole berries and a last scatter of crunchy oats, a little berry juice running down the inside of the glass, a second glass beside it; close and generous, filling most of the frame.
ystervarkies: ystervarkies: squares of vanilla sponge coated in chocolate icing and rolled in desiccated coconut, arranged on a cream cake stand, one cut in half to show the sponge.
